description: Use this when the user asks to find free days, open dates, vacation windows, long weekends, or consecutive days without hard Familia availability blockers. Do not use for listing tasks on one known date.

blockingPolicy.description: availability ignores soft reminders such as chores, checklists, birthdays/name days and ordinary tasks; strict treats any timeline item as busy.

busyEndHour.description: End hour of the day window to consider busy. Defaults to 24.

busyStartHour.description: Start hour of the day window to consider busy. Defaults to 0.

consecutiveDays.description: Required length of each free-day run. Defaults to 4.

horizonDays.description: How many days to scan forward from startDate. Defaults to 120.

householdId.description: Optional Familia household id. Omit to use all accessible households.

limit.description: Maximum number of free-day runs to return. Defaults to 8.

startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD or ISO datetime. Defaults to today.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used for day boundaries, e.g. Europe/Prague.

name: familia_find_free_days
title: Find consecutive free days
